4210-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4210-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Pious Evangel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

4681-5170-7452-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

539-2438-3821-4679-6821.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-2438-3821-4679-6821.description:
Cause Peregrine Drake to become an enchantment using Jump Scare.
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat from step 2.

5107-5261-7280.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
5107-5261-7280.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
5107-5261-7280.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Donatello.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1887-5254-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
1887-5254-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1887-5254-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7728-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Voracious Brood.
When Voracious Brood dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2738-4871-5686-6248.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Phenomenon Investigators, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

206-3259-3699.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
206-3259-3699.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1049-2034-5003.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least once this game.
1049-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jirina Kudro, adding {C}{C}.
When Jirina Kudro dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Jirina Kudro from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Jirina Kudro enters, it triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

6723-7060-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6723-7060-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6723-7060-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7415.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Old-Growth Educator.
When Old-Growth Educator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Old-Growth Educator enters, it triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

240-1251-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7232.easyPrerequisites: There are two tapped lands on the battlefield.
413-6972-7232.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ignition Team.
When Ignition Team dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Ignition Team enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

628-1477-7219.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Extruder ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-560-3899-4552-7170.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Living Brain.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1657-5508.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it and Railway Brawler trigger.
Resolve the Railway Brawler trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Murderous Redcap equal to its power.
Resolve the Murderous Redcap trigger, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

440-1339-3330-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-3330-4050.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

5220-5231-5683.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can be cast using {R}.
5220-5231-5683.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature that can be cast using {R}, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for the creature and putting it into your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1978-3301-3941.description:
Animate Coveted Jewel using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat from step 2.

348-394-1580-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Priest of Forgotten Gods does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
348-394-1580-2178.description:
Activate Priest of Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton and any other creature.
When Reassembling Skeleton and the other creature die, Priest of Forgotten Gods triggers twice, untapping Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Resolve the Priest of Forgotten Gods ability from step 1, causing any number of players to lose 2 life and sacrifice a creature, and you to add {B}{B} and draw a card.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Repeat.

2835-4050-4191-5010.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding one mana of any color.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

575-1788-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Den Protector, adding {1}.
When Den Protector dies, Yedora triggers, returning Den Protector from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Den Protector by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Den Protector's megamorph ability by paying {1}{G}, turning it face up.
Den Protector triggers, returning any card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2633-2871-3199.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
2633-2871-3199.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}.
Urabrask triggers, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

49-1799-3621-4050.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of eight or greater.
49-1799-3621-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding one mana of any color.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

4763-4766-5256.notablePrerequisites: Deahrender attached to another nontoken creature you control.
4763-4766-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Koll and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing a player to mill cards equal to the creature's power.
Repeat.

851-2034-5320.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
851-2034-5320.description:
Use Ashnod's Altar to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Adrix and Nev.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
851-2034-5320.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Ashnod's Altar, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

1887-2003-3609.notablePrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has at least one charge counter on it.
1887-2003-3609.description:
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting four charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1697-3398-5229.notablePrerequisites:
Neheb and Hellkite Charger do not have summoning sickness.
Neheb and Hellkite Charger can not be blocked.
The amount of cards in library is a multiple of 7.
1697-3398-5229.description:
Attack with Neheb and Hellkite Charger.
Hellkite Charger triggers.
Pay {5}{R}{R} to the trigger, gaining an extra combat phase and untapping all creatures you control.
Neheb deals combat damage, triggering.
With Neheb trigger, discard 7 cards and draw 7 cards, discards Ulamog when able, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
End combat.
Repeat.

914-1639-2649.manaNeeded: {1}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
914-1639-2649.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1639-2649.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W/U}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R} plus commander tax if applicable, putting it on top of Dockside Extortionist.
The Vadrok mutated creature triggers, allowing you to cast Winds of Rebuke from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Winds of Rebuke, returning Vadrok and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand and causing each player to mill two cards.
Repeat.
If your opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo produces infinite Treasure tokens.
